newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran executes six for armed robberies, murder.
newsitem.headline: Iran executes six for armed robberies, murder.

text.p: Iran has executed six men for belonging to a gang that carried out several armed robberies, killing one man and injuring several policemen, a newspaper said on Tuesday.

The daily Kayhan quoted a Tehran Revolutionay Court as saying the six men were executed in the Evin prison outside the capital after the Supreme Court upheld the death sentences. It did not say when the executions were carried out.
Mohammad Reza Golpaygani, identified as the gang's leader, was convicted of killing one man and robbing passengers of two buses, the newspaper said.

One man was convicted of taking part in five armed robberies and shooting and injuring an unspecified number of policemen during his arrest, it added. The four other gang members were convicted of several armed robberies at homes, restaurants, a transportation firm and a savings and loans office.
